label: Welcome
title: An invitation to explore
description: A quiet editorial opening: one clear promise, a sculptural artwork, and a single first step.

label: Explore / Home
title: The city, curated

label: Studio map
title: Find the work around you

label: Map filters
title: A focused filter sheet

label: Artist directory
title: Meet the makers
description: Distinct artwork thumbnails anchor open editorial rows. Typography carries the hierarchy.

label: Directory search
title: Search with context
description: Recent searches, categorized results, and a useful empty state make searching feel deliberate.

label: Artist profile
title: The story behind the work
description: A magazine-like artist profile connects biography, selected work, visiting details, and a studio map.

label: Artwork detail
title: Room for the art

label: Studio detail
title: A place worth visiting
description: A place sheet balances opening status, useful visitor information, and the people who work there.

label: My itinerary

label: Add a stop
title: A good detour

label: Walking route
title: Walk into the weekend

label: Weekend events
title: Make time for something new

label: Notifications
title: Useful, timely updates
description: Inbox entries and notification preferences occupy separate tabs, with clear unread and toggle states.

label: Community partners
title: Art happens together

label: Preferences / Settings
title: A quieter utility layer
